description: This file defines a data dictionary class for Informix databases within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction library. It includes methods for type mapping, altering and dropping columns, and generating SQL suffixes specific to Informix.

classes.name: ADODB2_informix
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_DataDict tailored for Informix, providing methods for data type mapping and SQL statement generation specific to Informix databases.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal metadata types to Informix-specific data types, with support for custom meta types.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method indicating alteration of columns is not supported in this class.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub method indicating dropping of columns is not supported in this class.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffix for column creation, handling auto-increment, default values, null constraints, and other constraints.
